title: Ripretinib induced skeletal muscle toxicity through mitochondrial impairment in C2C12 myotubes.
authors: Boran, Tugce; Zengin, Ozge Sultan; Seker, Zehra; Akyildiz, Aysenur Gunaydin; Oztas, Ezgi; Ozhan, Gul
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物ripretinib对骨骼肌细胞的线粒体毒性机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ripretinib is a multikinase inhibitor drug approved in 2020 by the FDA and in 2021 by EMA for use in the treatment of advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST) which have not adequately responded to previous treatments with kinase inhibitors. The most common side effects of the drug are myalgia and fatigue, which likely causes interruption of the treatment or reduction of the dose. Skeletal muscle cells highly depend on ATP to perform their functions and mitochondrial damage may play a role in skeletal muscle toxicity induced by kinase inhibitors. However, the molecular mechanism has not been clearly identified in the literature yet. In this study, it has been aimed to elucidate the role of mitochondria in the toxic effect of ripretinib on skeletal muscle using the mouse C2C12 myoblast-derived myotubes. The myotubes were exposed to ripretinib at the range of 1-20 muM concentrations for 24 h. To determine the potential role of mitochondrial impairment in ripretinib-induced skeletal muscle toxicity, intracellular ATP level, mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP), mitochondrial ROS production (mtROS), mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) copy number, and mitochondrial mass were examined after ripretinib treatment. Furthermore, changes in PGC 1alpha/NRF 1/NRF 2 expression levels that play a role in mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy were investigated. Additionally, the mitochondrial electron transport chain (ETC) enzyme activities were evaluated. Lastly, a molecular docking study was done to see ripretinib's possible interaction with DNA polymerase gamma (POLG) which is important for DNA replication in the mitochondria. According to the findings, ripretinib decreases the ATP level and mtDNA copy number, induces loss of MMP, and reduces mitochondrial mass. The activities of the ETC complexes were inhibited with ripretinib exposure which is in line with the observed ATP depletion and MMP loss. The molecular docking study revealed that ripretinib has inhibitory potential against POLG which supports the observed inhibition of mtDNA. The expression of PGC 1alpha was reduced in the nuclear fraction indicating that PGC-1alpha was not activated since the NRF 1 expression was reduced and NRF 2 level did not show significant change. Consequently, mtROS production increased in all treatment groups and mitophagy-related gene expressions and Parkin protein expression level were up-regulated at high doses. In conclusion, mitochondrial damage/loss can be one of the underlying causes of ripretinib-induced skeletal muscle toxicity. However, further studies are needed to confirm the results in vivo.
abstract_zh: 瑞普替尼（Ripretinib）是一种多激酶抑制剂药物，于2020年获得FDA批准，2021年获得EMA批准，用于治疗先前使用激酶抑制剂治疗反应不佳的晚期胃肠道间质瘤（GIST）。该药物最常见的副作用是肌痛和疲劳，这可能导致治疗中断或剂量减少。骨骼肌细胞高度依赖ATP来执行其功能，线粒体损伤可能在激酶抑制剂诱导的骨骼肌毒性中发挥作用。然而，其分子机制在文献中尚未明确阐明。本研究旨在利用小鼠C2C12成肌细胞衍生的肌管，阐明线粒体在瑞普替尼对骨骼肌毒性作用中的角色。肌管暴露于1-20 μM浓度的瑞普替尼24小时。为确定线粒体损伤在瑞普替尼诱导的骨骼肌毒性中的潜在作用，在瑞普替尼处理后检测了细胞内ATP水平、线粒体膜电位（MMP）、线粒体活性氧（mtROS）产生、线粒体DNA（mtDNA）拷贝数和线粒体质量。此外，还研究了在线粒体生物发生和线粒体自噬中起作用的PGC 1α/NRF 1/NRF 2表达水平的变化。同时，评估了线粒体电子传递链（ETC）酶活性。最后，进行了分子对接研究，以观察瑞普替尼与线粒体DNA复制中重要的DNA聚合酶γ（POLG）可能的相互作用。根据研究结果，瑞普替尼降低了ATP水平和mtDNA拷贝数，诱导MMP丧失，并减少线粒体质量。ETC复合物的活性在瑞普替尼暴露下受到抑制，这与观察到的ATP耗竭和MMP丧失一致。分子对接研究显示，瑞普替尼对POLG具有抑制潜力，这支持了观察到的mtDNA抑制。核部分中PGC 1α表达降低，表明PGC-1α未被激活，因为NRF 1表达减少，而NRF 2水平未显示显著变化。因此，所有处理组中mtROS产生增加，高剂量下线粒体自噬相关基因表达和Parkin蛋白表达水平上调。总之，线粒体损伤/丧失可能是瑞普替尼诱导的骨骼肌毒性的潜在原因之一。然而，需要进一步研究以在体内确认这些结果。
